## Notes

- Aircraft Mission Summary, 39.5, chart page 6 (jp2 100). Read from the archive.org scan; it is a list, not a grid, and every entry is checked against the rules section it cites.
- kind: strategic missions fly once a Game-Turn in the strategic air phase (39.13); land_support missions fly in an Operations Stage's land support air phase (39.14). role groups them as the chart does: fighter, bombing, non-combat.
- night: the chart marks the mission as one that may be flown at night (39.4). bombardment_table: strafing ports is resolved on the Air Bombardment Table.
- side cw on strafe-tanks: only Hurricane IIDs the Commonwealth owns (not captured ones) may strafe tanks. side axis on bomb-cw-ships: the Commonwealth has no ships to bomb other than its own, so only the Axis flies it (our reading of the chart's 'Commonwealth Ships').
- The two CAP over Malta entries cite no case on the chart.
